name: linkedindomhunter
description: **LinkedIn DOM Hunter** scrapes the `/people/` tab of any LinkedIn company page by interacting directly with the DOM via a stealth-patched Chromium instance. It supports pagination, result limiting, and an optional normalization pipeline that strips titles, suffixes, diacritics, and non-alphabetic characters — producing clean `Firstname Lastname` output ready for username generation or further enumeration.
